    "architecture": 8,
    "behavior": 8,

    "validation": 8,
    "overall": 8
  },
  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/management_domain.rs:175-207,218-232: context retirement only cancels management records that have not settled. A completed but unobserved record is retained, and observe_management checks only its operation ID and observed flag. Consequently, a read completed under tenant/context A can still return A's data after switching to B, replacing/removing the credential or resetting. Withdraw or invalidate not-yet-delivered results of retired contexts at the native boundary, including already-settled records. Acceptance: complete an A inventory/detail read without observing it, retire its context, then observe the old operation; it must refuse or return cancellation without A's payload. Cover tenant switch, credential replacement/removal and reset, while fresh-context reads still work.",
    "R2 (medium) — crates/desktop-core/src/management.rs:834,871-905: BindingCell stores Result inside OnceCell and bind uses get_or_init, permanently caching the first initialization error. If the Keychain is locked on the first read, unlocking it and explicitly refreshing still returns the cached CredentialLocked without reading the vault again. This contradicts the recovery guidance and requires an unrelated context rotation or reconfiguration to recover. Cache successful bindings while allowing explicit subsequent reads to retry transient initialization failures. Acceptance: store the management credential, make the first vault read return Locked and verify NotSent with no grant request; clear the vault failure without changing context or credential, then explicitly retry and obtain a successful read. Preserve scan separation and avoid automatic retry/replay.",
    "R3 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/features/administration/administration-view.tsx:79-93,140-154 and apps/desktop/src/shell/desktop-shell.tsx:164: Administration retains page/detail state across context changes and clears it only in a passive effect. Independently reproduced the actual component committing tenant A's profile rows under the new 'Read-only inventories of Tenant B' label before that effect clears them. Post-effect assertions miss this mixed projection. Bind displayed state synchronously to its context, or remount the stateful view when that context changes; preserve the existing late-reply guards. Acceptance: inspect the commit in a layout effect during A-to-B and credential-generation transitions and verify no earlier rows, details or failure state render under the new context, even while the new first-page read is pending."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "E1 — C08 refactors the shared credential configuration/removal/retirement and persistence paths in crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs and store.rs, and modifies tests/context_credentials/main.rs, but none of the submitted runs executes the C02 context_credentials target. Native C02/C03 regressions and the new management tests do not replace the existing injected write-ahead, interrupted commit, cleanup and reset matrix for the refactored scan path. Supply a source-bound passing run of cargo test --locked -p desktop-core --features test-fixtures --test context_credentials on the reviewed tree, with its exact command, raw log, status and fingerprints included in a new immutable packet."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "Independently verified all four supplied fingerprints, the 339-entry source inventory, all 171 packet references, recorded tool binaries, run/log/artifact hashes, consumed shared-package inputs and the passing C07 and P02 predecessor receipts. Frozen inputs were rechecked before writing. Hash consistency establishes retained-byte binding, not cryptographic proof of run authorship.",
    "R1 and R2 are direct source-path analyses. The submitted replacement-mid-pagination test exercises an unsettled operation, and the vault test stops after the first locked read; neither exercises the remaining cases described above. Did not run filesystem-writing Rust tests or implement fixes because this request permits writes only to its designated verdict.",
    "Independently executed an in-memory React/JSDOM probe of the actual AdministrationView with scripted management reads and simplified presentation leaves. A parent layout effect captured tenant B's label with tenant A's profile row; after passive effects, the old row disappeared. This establishes the mixed committed projection, not a measured native-window flicker duration.",
    "The separate management credential class, token-origin binding, TSG admission, SDK session cancellation, explicit scan-profile selection, bounded paging/detail walk, recursive redaction and unknown-value presentation are present in the inspected paths. Compared the operation map with v1 bridge operations.ts and inspected the pinned SDK management/model source. The SDK archive SHA-256 6d555d955c3734dd5ee78f7173569bdecd4426095b2ffedc4b77d8f0f2c2e8d9 matches Cargo.lock, and the inspected SDK files match their archive bytes. No live management behavior was inferred from synthetic fixtures.",
    "Submitted passing results report 235 desktop tests, 64 core unit tests, 12 management integration tests, 105 selected frontend tests overlapping the desktop total, and 44 controller tests. All 23 recorded mutations trigger their named guards and six baselines pass. These results establish their covered cases; E1 identifies the missing affected regression execution.",
    "All 102 submitted native checks report pass: 12 C08 checks and 90 C01-C07 regression checks, all naming executable 9d4e651e820e18f331c7328f90500c941d4051552ab750b559f5190eb7902fe3. Inspected relevant management observations, including scan-only operation, grant refusal, paging, redaction, replacement and class-scoped removal. Native interaction was not repeated; spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded.",
    "D034 and the revised completion-controller policy were inspected as submitted code and policy evidence. This verdict uses the requested independent pass criteria and does not grant an owner waiver or raise scores to satisfy a threshold. Controller regression execution is present in this packet.",
    "No application source was changed, no product endpoint was called and no real credential was accessed. This review covers C08 and its affected integration boundaries, not subsequent management writes or complete product qualification. Live management qualification remains C25 and signed installed-package qualification remains C26."
  ],
